Name: Waterside Flamingos (Barn Animals)
Author: PiratePapaya
Description:
[size=3][b]Waterside Flamingos[/b] 🦩💦
[/size][size=3][i]Because your farm deserves fabulous pink legs.

[/i][/size][size=3][b]About:[/b]
Ever felt your farm was missing a little tropical glamour? 🌴 Now you can raise flamingos as a brand-new barn animal[i].
[/i]
[/size][*][size=3][b]Seasonal Availability:[/b] Only sold at [b]Marnie’s Ranch[/b] in [b]Summer[/b].[/size]
[size=3]
[*][b]Farm Builldings:[/b] Requires a [b]Barn[/b].
[/size][size=3]
[*][b]Loves the Water’s Edge:[/b] Keep them near water to watch them stroll and forage.

[*][b]Special Produce:[/b] Just as pigs dig up truffles, flamingos deliver [b]Shrimp[/b] 🦐 and [b]Crab[/b] 🦀, so you can get fresh seafood without ever fishing or using crab pots.[size=3] Flamingos also lay eggs, which require an [b]Ostrich Incubator[/b] to hatch.[/size]

[i]
The lawn flamingo you bought at the Egg Festival isn’t lonely anymore—it’s now a real, strolling flamingo! 🦩 :)


[/i][u][i]Update:
• Flamingo eggs → mayo → Preserves Jar → Keg → special wine[/i]
[/u][i][u]


[b]Update 2. 0[/b][b]
[/b][*]New Furniture:  A flamingo-themed dining table you can find in your furniture catalog.
[*]New Recipes: [size=3][i][u]Try out desserts and other treats made from flamingo products.[/u][/i][/size]


[/u][/i]
[/size]
